head: A fresh wallet.
body:
Nothing in it. This is where
a judge starts.

head: Two steps.
body:
Type what you keep putting off.
That's the name.

head: Test tokens, one tap.
body:
Our devnet faucet pays the fee.
Nothing to sign.

head: Four weeks. Five a week.
body:
Miss one and that week's stake
goes to a cause you picked up front.

head: Locked in.
body:
Every week's stake is set.
Demo speed: a week here is 2 minutes.

head: Hold to stamp.
body:
A second and a half.
Add a note, just for you.

head: Showed up.
body:
Stamped. Confetti.
A line for the week.

head: Settled by the app.
body:
No approval. KEPT.
Stake back, note on the receipt.

head: A missed week.
body:
That week's stake went to the food bank.
"That's a week, not a verdict."
